---
title: "A supervision, authorship or collaboration problem feels stuck"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Diagnose

Separate unclear expectations, ordinary disagreement, repeated non-performance, contribution dispute, power/coercion and unsafe conduct.

## Do now

1. Preserve factual dated records and relevant agreements.
2. Identify the decision, role and applicable standard.
3. State each position faithfully.
4. Propose a bounded resolution and review date.
5. Seek independent advice when authority or power makes direct resolution unsafe.
6. Keep sensitive details in the authorised confidential process.

## Before asking

Bring the output-specific contribution record, relevant messages/decisions, impact, attempted resolution and requested protection or decision.

## Stop or escalate

Use independent formal routes for bullying, harassment, discrimination, retaliation, authorship coercion, suspected misconduct or conflicts of interest. Do not rely only on a person implicated in the concern.

## Evidence of unstuck

Roles, decision and actions are recorded; required protection or review is active; downstream authorship/project records are updated.

Use the [authorship record](../templates/authorship-conversation.qmd) and [escalation builder](../templates/escalation-message.qmd).
